subject.title: ci: repin ClawSweeper to client-id engine

question: Should the repository approve this staged Client ID token-minting rollout before a default-branch canary can provide live evidence?
rationale: The changed reusable workflow affects GitHub App authentication, while the only executable caller is sourced from the default branch after merge; AGENTS.md reserves this approval to humans.

options.title: Approve a staged canary
options.body: Approve the immutable pin, then require a redacted default-branch canary result before treating the migration as fully validated.

options.title: Hold for alternate pre-merge proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers identify a safe pre-merge environment that can execute the new caller configuration.

recommendation.title: Approve a staged canary
recommendation.body: Approve the immutable pin, then require a redacted default-branch canary result before treating the migration as fully validated.
